---
title: "EDAM Training"
---

Welcome to the EDAM September 2026 training materials. This site is the rendered,
read-only version of the course. You can view the course content here, but we
recommend running the material yourself (see below).

## Materials

- [**Session 1: cleaning and exporing data**](session_1/session_1_SOLUTIONS.Rmd) - a tutorial on
  how to clean your data, work with shapefiles, and use descriptive plots to answer policy questions.
- [**Session 2: creating an explainable ML pipeline**](session_2/xgboost_shap_workflow_tutorial.Rmd) - a tutorial on
  explainable AI, covering how to train a model (XGBoost) and interpret SHAP values.

## Running the material yourself

To run the code, clone the repository (<https://github.com/EDAM-Consortium/september-training-2026>)
or [download it as a zip file](https://github.com/EDAM-Consortium/september-training-2026/archive/refs/heads/main.zip),
then open the `.Rmd` file for the session you want, leaving it inside its own folder. Keep each
session's `data/` folder alongside its `.Rmd` — the code reads data using paths relative to that
folder.

Note that session 1 comes in two versions: an exercise version (`session_1/session_1_EXERCISES.Rmd`), which
has blanks for you to fill in and questions to answer based on your results, and a solutions version
(`session_1/session_1_SOLUTIONS.Rmd`), which is the one rendered on this website. We suggest you try
the exercises first and consult the solutions when you get stuck.
